$schema-note: This file is the single source of truth for the closed `assetRole` enum. The same id list appears in schema/pagespec.schema.json (definitions.assetRole.enum) and in tokens/llm/component-allowlist.json (assetRoles). extraction/verify_all.py enforces that all three agree; a role added to one and not the others fails the run.
complianceBanner: natural.com is a REAL, LIVE company's website. Every string of copy in this design-repo was transcribed verbatim from it, and every file under the clone's public/assets/ is a real downloaded brand asset belonging to Natural AI, Inc. Nothing in this design-repo grants any license to that material. The rules in `globalProhibitions` below are not style guidance — they are hard constraints on anything an AI generates from this repo.
globalProhibitions: NEVER reproduce, redraw, recolor, or approximate Natural's real wordmark or logo in generated output. The `brand.wordmark` role exists to describe where a mark sits, not to license reuse.
NEVER reproduce, or generate a lookalike of, a real employee, customer, investor, or founder photograph. Every portrait in this repo is a photograph of a real identifiable person.

NEVER reproduce a real third-party company's logo (Eight Sleep, Whoop, Equinox, or any investor firm's mark). The site itself renders investor marks as a GENERIC placeholder glyph, and a generated page must do the same or omit the mark entirely.

NEVER present Natural's verbatim marketing copy, product claims, pricing, FDIC/legal disclosures, or investor quotes as the generated page's own content. The copy in schema/example.pagespec.json is evidence of the site's real voice and length budgets — it is not reusable text.

NEVER fabricate a regulatory, banking, or FDIC-insurance claim. The site's disclosures name a real bank (Column N.A.) and a real insurance mechanism; inventing a variation of these is a legal risk, not a copy choice.
This design-repo must NOT be published, open-sourced, or made a public repository.

aiGenerationVocabulary.may-generate-new: An AI may synthesise a brand-new asset for this role, as long as it matches the documented visual treatment. No real-world referent is implied.
aiGenerationVocabulary.must-reuse-exact: An AI must reference the existing asset path unchanged. It may not regenerate, restyle, crop, or recolor it.
aiGenerationVocabulary.must-not-fabricate: An AI may reference the existing asset path if and only if the generated page is a faithful reconstruction of this same site. It must NEVER synthesise a substitute, because any substitute would be a fabricated depiction of a real person, a real brand, or a real regulated entity.

brand.wordmark.description: Natural's logotype in the navbar and footer.
brand.wordmark.licensing: Natural AI, Inc. trademark. Not licensed for reuse or imitation. A generated page for a DIFFERENT brand must substitute that brand's own mark or a neutral placeholder — never a variation of this one.

photo.hero-product.description: The large product screenshot at the top of each of the 10 product routes, and the scroll-revealed dashboard on the homepage hero.
photo.hero-product.licensing: These are screenshots of Natural's real, unreleased product UI. Do not reproduce them and do not synthesise a fake product UI that could be mistaken for Natural's.

photo.feature-graphic.description: The 3-up feature-card illustrations on each product route.
photo.feature-graphic.licensing: These are abstract product illustrations with no real person or third-party mark in them. A generated page may synthesise replacements in the same soft, desaturated, photographic-abstract register. It may NOT reuse Natural's originals for a non-Natural brand.

photo.splash.description: The brand splash photograph under the final CTA and mid-page on /about; the team photograph mid-page on /careers.
photo.splash.licensing: nature-desk.jpg is Natural's commissioned brand photography. team-image.jpg depicts real, identifiable Natural employees. Neither may be reproduced, and no lookalike may be generated.

texture.overlay.description: The four blended texture films stacked over every splash photograph.
texture.overlay.licensing: Generic scanned-paper/grain films carrying no brand identity. Reference the four paths unchanged; the ordered blend stack is the design, and substituting or reordering films breaks it.

portrait.agent.description: The square portrait used for the fictional agent 'Penny' in the Control card and the Home benefit card.
portrait.agent.renderedAt: 48px (6px radius) in the benefit card; 160px (radius.lg) in the Control card
portrait.agent.licensing: Although the agent persona is fictional, the image is a real photograph sourced by Natural. Do not reproduce it and do not generate a substitute portrait, which would be a synthetic depiction of a person.

portrait.owner.description: The 18px circular avatar of the agent's human owner in the Control card.
portrait.owner.licensing: A photograph of a person. Same rule as portrait.agent.

portrait.team.description: Photographs of Natural employees on the /careers team-quote cards.
portrait.team.licensing: Real, identifiable employees of a real company. Never reproduce, never generate a lookalike, and never attach a generated quote to a real person's face.

photo.blog-hero.description: The hero image for a blog post, used on the homepage Blog section and the /blog index.
photo.blog-hero.licensing: A large share of these are portrait photographs of named, real Natural employees (the 'why X joined Natural' series). Treat the whole set as must-not-fabricate rather than auditing which individual files contain a face.

icon.product.description: The 8 monochrome product glyphs in the Home icon grid.
icon.product.licensing: Generic single-color financial glyphs carrying no brand identity. A generated page may synthesise equivalents in the same weight.

icon.verified.description: The badge glyph beside a verified agent name.
icon.verified.note: Rendered as an in the Home benefit card but as an INLINE
icon.verified.licensing: A generic checkmark-in-a-seal. No brand identity.

decor.logo-placeholder.description: The generic circle-and-plus glyph the investor cards render INSTEAD of a real investor firm's logo.
decor.logo-placeholder.licensing: This role exists specifically to AVOID reproducing real venture-firm marks. Substituting a real logo here is a direct violation of globalProhibitions. Keep the placeholder or omit the glyph.

logo.partner.description: Third-party wellness-partner logos on the /careers Perks section.
logo.partner.licensing: Trademarks of Eight Sleep, WHOOP, and Equinox — third parties with no relationship to this design-repo. Never reproduce, redraw, or generate a variation. A generated page should omit partner logos entirely unless it has its own real, licensed partners.

photo.section-graphic.description: Full-bleed background photographs behind an interactive stage (the Flows tab stage; the Developers explorer panel), plus the small floating card images that sit on top of the Flows stage.
photo.section-graphic.licensing: Abstract photographic backdrops. The four flows-* card images depict product UI and are closer to photo.hero-product in sensitivity — do not reproduce those as a real Natural product; synthesise a neutral card if a replacement is needed.

photo.trust-badge.description: The FDIC coverage card image, reused on the Home 'Scale' section and on the /wallet and /vault product routes.
photo.trust-badge.licensing: This image asserts a real regulatory insurance claim tied to a real bank partnership. Reproducing it, or generating a variation asserting FDIC coverage, is a regulatory-misrepresentation risk. Omit it.
